explanation: A symbolic enemy of God's people, often interpreted as a nation or coalition of nations.
A land or people associated with Gog, who take part in the attack against Israel.
A prophet in the Old Testament who delivered God's message to the people of Israel.
Prediction or revelation of future events given by God through a prophet.
A period of divine intervention and judgment, where God acts to protect His people and punish their enemies.
The name of God's chosen people and the geographical area they inhabited in the Old Testament.
A title for God that emphasizes His sovereignty and power over all forces and armies in the world.
An act in which something is given to God as a gesture of gratitude, devotion, or atonement for sin.
A type of offering where an animal was burned on an altar as a holy act to God.
A time period mentioned in Ezekiel 39, symbolizing completeness and divine intervention.
